messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Your People Portal profile is verified. We have released the screening invitation; the screening itself is not yet cleared. Payroll preference and employment-verification paperwork remain separate open tasks.

Best,
Jordan

messages.subject: Reminder: complete your profile before October 15
messages.body:
Hi Alex,

This scheduled reminder concerns the same People Portal profile task in your welcome checklist. If you already received a profile verification confirmation, no additional profile is required. This reminder does not reverse that confirmation.

Best,
Jordan

messages.subject: Please confirm my October 19 laptop appointment
messages.body:
Hello Orbit IT,

Could you confirm the time and location for my October 19 laptop setup and the start time of the welcome session? I want to complete setup before joining.

Thanks,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: Please confirm my October 19 laptop appointment
messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Your laptop appointment is October 19 at 9 a.m. Pacific in the fictional Orbit Welcome Room A. The virtual welcome session begins at 10 a.m. Pacific. An access link will be provided through the secure portal.

This confirms the schedule, not attendance or completed setup.

Orbit IT Welcome Team

messages.subject: First-day status - two paperwork items remain open
messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Your profile and screening are complete; IT confirmed laptop setup and the welcome team confirmed attendance. The attached status receipt lists the evidence.

Payroll preference remains unconfirmed, due October 20. Employment-verification paperwork is still under review. Benefits election is also open, due November 17.

Best,
Jordan

steps.title: Build one plan
steps.trigger: Load HR and IT welcome emails.
steps.expected: Create distinct tasks with deadlines, dependencies and missing appointment details.
steps.mustNot: Do not duplicate laptop setup or invent a location.

evidence.quote: The laptop appointment time and location are not yet assigned.

steps.title: Advance one dependency
steps.expected: Complete profile; release screening task without marking screening cleared.
steps.mustNot: Do not complete downstream tasks.

evidence.quote: the screening itself is not yet cleared.

steps.title: Deduplicate stale reminders
steps.trigger: Deliver the scheduled reminder after confirmation.
steps.expected: Keep profile complete; associate reminder with existing task.
steps.mustNot: Do not reopen the profile without a substantive correction request.

evidence.quote: This reminder does not reverse that confirmation.

steps.title: Ask only for missing details
steps.expected: Ask IT for time and location.
steps.mustNot: Do not ask HR to repeat already confirmed profile status.

evidence.quote: confirm the time and location

steps.title: Record an appointment
steps.expected: Record 9 a.m. setup and 10 a.m. orientation on October 19.
steps.mustNot: Do not equate scheduling with attendance.

evidence.quote: not attendance or completed setup.

steps.title: Keep remaining work visible
steps.trigger: Simulate first-day activities; deliver status receipt.
steps.expected: Close four confirmed items and retain payroll, paperwork and benefits tasks.
steps.mustNot: Do not mark all onboarding complete.

evidence.quote: Payroll payment preference remains unconfirmed
